deep.title: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash lets you build with more control
deep.score_reason: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash更新，头部模型迭代，提供更多控制能力，对应用构建有直接影响。
deep.analysis:
谷歌发布了 Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash，这是其 Omni 多模态模型系列的一个新版本，核心定位是“更可控的构建体验”。它不是一个从零开始的新模型，而是在原有 Omni 架构基础上，针对开发者对输出精确控制的需求所做的定向优化。

此前，多模态生成模型普遍存在一个痛点：模型能力很强，但行为不够“听话”。开发者调用 API 时，往往只能通过简单的提示词来引导模型，但模型对输出格式、风格、内容边界等方面的遵循度不稳定。比如，要求生成严格符合 JSON Schema 的结构化数据，模型可能偶尔多出一个字段；要求图像生成中保持特定品牌色，模型可能产生色偏。这种不确定性让模型很难直接嵌入到对可靠性要求高的生产管线中，开发者不得不额外编写大量的后处理校验和重试逻辑，增加了系统复杂度和延迟。

这次更新的技术要点集中在“可控性”上，资料明确提到了几个关键机制。首先是结构化输出能力的增强，模型能够更严格地遵循开发者指定的输出模式，这对于需要将生成结果直接喂给下游函数或数据库的场景至关重要。其次是引入了“思考预算”控制，这相当于让开发者可以调节模型在推理时投入的计算资源——预算低时模型快速响应，适合简单任务；预算高时模型进行更深度的思考，适合复杂推理。这种可调节性让同一模型能适配不同延迟和精度要求的场景，而不需要切换不同规格的模型。此外，模型在指令遵循的细粒度上做了改进，能够更精准地理解并执行诸如“用第三人称”“排除特定话题”之类的约束条件。

对 AI 应用岗而言，这条资讯有几个值得在面试中展开的点。第一，它体现了大模型应用从“能力展示”到“生产可用”的工程化趋势——面试官很可能追问“你如何保证模型输出的可靠性”，此时可以引用结构化输出和思考预算作为业界解法，并对比自己项目中的实践。第二，思考预算机制本质上是一种“用计算换质量”的调度策略，这涉及成本与效果的权衡，是后端 AI 系统设计中的常见考题。第三，多模态场景下的可控性比纯文本更难，因为图像、音频等模态的约束空间更复杂，面试中如果遇到多模态产品设计题，可以借此说明对模态差异的理解。最后，资料强调这是 Flash 系列，意味着它在速度上做了优化，适合需要低延迟的实时交互应用，这提醒我们在技术选型时不能只看模型能力排行榜，还要结合场景的延迟和成本约束做决策。

deep.title: Why We Rebuilt LangChain’s Chatbot and What We Learned
deep.summary: Learn how LangChain rebuilt their chatbot using Deep Agents and subgraphs for sub-15-second responses with precise citations—and what you can apply.
deep.score_reason: LangChain官方工程博客，详细介绍了用Deep Agents和subgraph重构chatbot实现<15秒响应和精确引用，有具体方法和可复现经验，对agent工程实践有直接参考价值。
deep.analysis:
去年 LangChain 团队彻底重写了自家的文档问答聊天机器人，从早期基于简单 RAG 的版本升级为基于 Deep Agents 和子图架构的新系统。这次重构的核心目标很明确：把端到端响应时间压到 15 秒以内，同时保证回答中引用的文档片段精确可追溯。

此前他们面临的主要痛点是传统 RAG 模式在复杂查询下的表现不稳定。旧版聊天机器人采用“检索-生成”的线性流程，但用户提问往往不是一步就能解决的——比如问“如何用 LangGraph 实现带条件分支的 agent”，这需要先理解 LangGraph 的基本概念，再定位到条件分支的具体实现，最后把两者关联起来。单一检索很难一次性拿到所有相关上下文，导致回答要么遗漏关键信息，要么引用不准确。此外，旧系统在响应速度上也逐渐失控，多轮检索和重排序让延迟累积到用户难以接受的程度。

新系统的技术核心在于两个设计决策。第一是采用 Deep Agents 范式，也就是让 agent 自主规划执行路径，而不是硬编码的线性流程。当用户提问时，agent 会先分析问题需要哪些子任务，然后动态决定调用哪些工具、按什么顺序执行。比如遇到需要对比两个概念的问题，agent 可能先分别检索两个概念的定义，再检索它们的关联文档，最后综合生成回答。第二是引入子图架构，把整个 agent 的执行逻辑拆分成多个可复用的子图，每个子图负责一个独立能力单元，比如文档检索子图、代码示例检索子图、引用验证子图等。这样做的好处是子图可以并行执行，大幅缩短总耗时，同时每个子图的输出带有明确的来源标注，让最终回答的每一句引用都能追溯到具体文档段落。团队还特别优化了引用精度，在生成阶段强制模型只基于检索到的片段作答，并在输出中嵌入引用标记，用户点击即可跳转到对应文档位置。

对 AI 应用岗面试来说，这个案例有多个可深入讨论的点。首先是生产环境中响应时间的约束如何驱动架构决策——15 秒不是拍脑袋的数字，而是用户可接受的等待上限，这直接影响了子图并行化的设计。其次是 agent 的可控性问题，Deep Agents 虽然灵活，但完全自主规划可能带来不可预测的行为，LangChain 通过子图边界限制了 agent 的自由度，每个子图内部是确定性流程，agent 只在子图调度层面做决策，这是一种务实的折中。面试中如果被问到“如何设计一个生产可用的 AI 应用”，可以引用这个案例说明：不是越智能越好，而是在智能和可控之间找到平衡点，同时用并行化保证性能，用引用机制保证可信度。最后，这个重构也体现了 AI 应用迭代的典型路径——从简单的线性流程起步验证可行性，再根据真实用户反馈识别瓶颈，针对性地引入 agent 和并行化，而不是一开始就过度设计。

deep.title: PILOT in the Loop: Live Self-Improvement for Long-Horizon Agents
deep.summary: Long-horizon agent runs generate experience that can improve both the current run and future work. Most self-improvement methods process this experience only after execution ends, so they cannot redirect the active run or immediately apply and validate lessons learned from it. We argue that self-improvement should instead be live, using emerging experience both to redirect the active run and to update the persistent harness. Existing agent architectures do not fully support this goal. Single-agent self-correction combines task execution and trajectory assessment within one context, while subagent delegation separates execution but typically cannot redirect an active subagent. We present PILOT, a supervisor-worker harness for live self-improvement through two coupled mechanisms: (1) live steering lets a separate supervisor redirect or abort the active worker during execution; and (2) live self-evolution distils procedures and failure modes revealed during execution into reusable skills and memory. Across two frozen backbones and three benchmarks, PILOT ranks first in five of six configurations. On Terminal-Bench 2.0, PILOT outperforms counterpart harnesses by up to 9.8 percentage points. In the self-improvement setting, PILOT gains 14.6 points with GLM-5.1 and 12.4 points with Kimi-K2.6. Mean output tokens fall by 42.9% and 47.4%, while successful evaluations per million output tokens rise by 110.3% and 134.0%, respectively.
deep.score_reason: 长程 agent 在线自改进方法，直接解决 agent 生产中的实时反馈难题，方法新颖且可复现，upvotes 21 佐证质量。
deep.analysis:
这是一篇关于让长周期AI智能体在运行过程中实时自我改进的新研究，提出了一个名为PILOT的监督者-工作者架构。

它解决的核心痛点是现有自我改进方法的滞后性。目前，大多数AI智能体在执行长周期任务时，会将运行过程中产生的经验数据保存下来，但分析和改进都发生在任务完全结束后。这就好比一个学生在考试结束后才去对答案，虽然对下次考试有帮助，但无法挽救本次考试中的错误。这种事后处理模式无法在任务执行中途纠正方向，也无法立即验证从当前经验中学到的教训。此外，现有的单智能体自我纠错机制将任务执行和轨迹评估混在同一个上下文中，容易导致注意力分散；而子智能体委派模式虽然分离了执行，但通常无法干预正在运行的子智能体。这些架构缺陷限制了智能体在复杂、长周期任务中的表现上限。

PILOT的技术方法要点在于设计了一套耦合的实时机制，让自我改进发生在任务进行时。其核心架构是一个监督者-工作者模式，通过两个关键机制实现：第一是“实时转向”，它设置了一个独立的监督者智能体，该监督者不直接执行任务，而是持续观察工作者智能体的执行轨迹，有权在运行过程中实时重定向或中止工作者的行为。这解决了传统架构中监督与执行耦合或无法干预的问题。第二是“实时自我进化”，它能够从执行过程中暴露出的流程和失败模式中即时提炼知识，将其转化为可复用的技能和记忆，并更新到持久化的工具集中。这意味着智能体不仅能在本次任务中及时纠错，还能将本次运行中的发现立即固化为能力，供后续任务使用，形成了一个在线的学习闭环。

对AI应用岗而言，这项工作的意义在于它直接指向了生产环境中智能体系统的可靠性与效率问题。在面试中，你可以从以下几个角度切入讨论：首先，PILOT的架构分离了“执行”与“监督”的关注点，这是一种更工程化的设计思路，类似于微服务中的控制平面与数据平面分离，能提升系统的可维护性和稳定性。其次，其实时自我进化能力带来了显著的效率提升，数据显示，使用GLM-5.1和Kimi-K2.6两种模型时，PILOT的平均输出token数分别下降了42.9%和47.4%，而每百万输出token的成功评估次数分别提升了110.3%和134.0%。这说明系统通过实时学习避免了大量无效探索，直接降低了API调用成本并提升了任务成功率，这是面试官非常看重的成本效益权衡。最后，你可以强调这种“在线学习”范式对构建生产级AI应用的启发：未来的智能体不应只是静态的提示词和工具链，而应是一个能在运行中持续观察、反思、并固化经验的动态系统，这要求我们在应用架构设计时就预留出实时干预和知识沉淀的接口。

mid.title: TTPO: Test-Time Policy Optimization
mid.summary: Recent prominent post-training methods, such as Reinforcement Learning (RL) and On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), have driven rapid progress in mathematical reasoning for large language models, yet their reliance on ground-truth labels precludes test-time training (TTT). Replacing ground truth with majority-vote pseudo-labels is a natural alternative, yet it is fragile: an incorrect vote corrupts the teacher and misleads every token. We observe that this failure mode is asymmetric: rollouts that disagree with the pseudo-label are typically wrong regardless of whether the vote itself is correct. Building on this observation, we propose Test-Time Policy Optimization (TTPO), an asymmetric objective that distills agreeing rollouts via OPSD and penalizes disagreeing rollouts with Grouped RL. Token-level selection further refines both branches: distillation down-weights already-converged positions, while RL penalizes only confident errors. Both updates remain well-grounded even under frequent pseudo-label errors, and majority-vote routing yields tighter self-supervision as the model improves. Without any labels, TTPO matches label-supervised OPSD on five competition-level benchmarks, raises Qwen3-1.7B from 38.0% to 45.2% in TTT, yields +25.2% to +36.4% without thinking, and shows strong cross-task generalization.
mid.score_reason: 测试时策略优化方法，无需真实标签即可在推理时训练，对提升模型推理能力有直接工程价值，upvotes 48 高。
mid.analysis: TTPO（Test-Time Policy Optimization）是一种无需真实标签的测试时训练方法，旨在提升大语言模型的数学推理能力。其核心创新在于提出非对称优化目标：对与多数投票伪标签一致的推理路径使用在线策略自蒸馏进行强化，对不一致的路径则通过分组强化学习施加惩罚，并辅以令牌级选择来细化更新。该方法解决了传统后训练方法依赖真实标签、而伪标签易因错误投票导致模型被误导的脆弱性问题。值得关注的是，TTPO在无任何标签的情况下，在五个竞赛级基准上性能媲美有监督方法，并将Qwen3-1.7B的测试时训练准确率从38.0%提升至45.2%，展现出强大的跨任务泛化能力。

paper.title: The Handoff Tax: Continuing Non-Native Trajectories in LLM Agents
paper.summary: Coding agents perform long-running tasks spanning dozens of model calls, tool uses, and code edits. As these runs unfold, users face a practical cost-quality trade-off: escalating to a stronger model when a cheaper one struggles, or downshifting once the hard reasoning is complete. Each switch requires the receiver to continue a non-native trajectory produced by another model. We study how this handoff affects quality and cost, and how varying the trajectory information inherited by the receiver changes the outcome. Using pairs of low-cost, low-capability (LC) and high-cost, high-capability (HC) models from the Claude and GPT families, we vary handoff direction, timing, and interface, comparing full-trajectory transfer, compaction, and trajectory removal while preserving the repository state. Across both model families, full-trajectory escalation recovers less than half of the LC-to-HC quality gap while incurring a substantial cost premium. We term this cost-quality penalty the handoff tax. By contrast, downshift offers a favorable cost-quality point. Interestingly, the preferred interface also reverses with direction: reducing LC-model trajectory information improves escalation quality, whereas removing the HC-model trajectory reduces downshift quality.

paper.title: Prefix Sliding for efficient test-time scaling
paper.summary: Test-time scaling uses extra test-time compute to improve performance, such as letting language models reason longer when solving a problem. As models keep the entire reasoning trace in memory via full attention, hard tasks that need long thinking can be prohibitively expensive. However, we find most intermediate reasoning tokens lose importance as the model continues reasoning. This calls into question whether retaining them is worth the cost. Based on this insight, we propose Prefix Sliding, which discards tokens during reasoning that are not part of the prefix or the window of the last few thousand tokens. The prefix has key instructions and tools available to the model, while the most recent tokens are the current reasoning the model is working on. This caps the total memory requirement regardless of how long the model reasons, allowing for efficient long-horizon test-time scaling. Without training, Prefix Sliding can make existing models 3x faster while maintaining performance. Training with Prefix Sliding using reinforcement learning can achieve better performance by enabling scaling to reasoning traces beyond a hundred thousand tokens. Ablations show Prefix Sliding outperforms summarizing intermediate tokens or vanilla sliding window. Our code is at https://github.com/Muennighoff/prefix-sliding

paper.title: Is Next-Chunk Reasoning RL Really Better than SFT? Revisiting Training Strategies under no-CoT Data
paper.summary: Recent work proposes next-chunk reasoning RL for leveraging no-CoT data---corpora such as worked solutions and textbook derivations that contain reasoning-rich content but lack explicit chain-of-thought annotations. The method trains a model to generate implicit reasoning traces and rewards them by their ability to predict the next chunk of text. While promising, existing evaluations primarily compare against conventional SFT baselines, leaving open whether the gains come from the RL formulation itself or from more effectively exposing the model to no-CoT data. We address this question with a controlled study of next-chunk reasoning RL and a simple but previously overlooked alternative: Mixed SFT, a single supervised fine-tuning stage that jointly trains on no-CoT and long-CoT data. Despite its simplicity, Mixed SFT achieves a clearly higher post-RLVR performance ceiling than next-chunk reasoning RL while requiring over 60 times less training compute. The advantage is consistent across in-domain mathematical reasoning and out-of-domain reasoning tasks. Moreover, we show that higher pre-RLVR accuracy does not necessarily translate into higher post-RLVR accuracy, highlighting the need to evaluate no-CoT training strategies in the context of the full post-training pipeline.

paper.title: Training Agents to Evolve with Their Harness: TaoLive Digital Avatar Agent Technical Report
paper.summary: AI-powered digital avatar streamers must answer product questions, engage viewers, and execute marketing strategies in real time, demanding low latency, frequent strategy updates, and accurate yet effective responses. Evolvable Harnesses, whose Skills, Hooks, prompts, and tools can be updated independently of model weights, enable rapid iteration but expose a trade-off: large models adapt zero-shot yet are too slow, whereas compact models meet latency targets but overfit to fixed Harness configurations. We propose Harness-Aware Training (HAT), which trains compact models to adapt to changing Harnesses. Its key component, Harness-State Augmentation (HSA), applies task-preserving transformations to Skill identifiers and content, tool schemas, prompt structures, and Hook functions. Training proceeds in three stages: HSA-SFT learns reasoning and tool use from strong-model trajectories across diverse environments; General On-Policy Distillation restores generalization lost during SFT; and HSA-RL improves robustness to changing Harnesses through reinforcement learning in augmented environments.
